change_request.title: Add a non-null column to the orders table and backfill 80 million rows

approvals.name: S. Idowu
approvals.status: approved with a comment: 'only if the backfill is batched'

state.capacity: Expected backfill time is 50 minutes in staging with 10 percent of production data.
state.notes: The change record does not say whether the backfill is batched. The change board secretary says the sale event may have been added after approval.

constraints.statement: Run schema migrations on tables used by checkout during a declared sales event.
Require a verified backup newer than 24 hours before any destructive or schema change.
Prefer moving a risky change to a quiet window over cancelling it.

reference_facts.name: orders_table_role
reference_facts.value: Used by checkout and payments on every order

change_decision.instructions: Choose the gate decision for this change request.
